examples.en: January is the first month of the year.
examples.zh: 一月是一年的第一個月。

examples.en: We have a winter vacation in January.
examples.zh: 我們一月有寒假。

examples.en: February is the shortest month.
examples.zh: 二月是最短的月份。

examples.en: My birthday is in February.
examples.zh: 我的生日在二月。

examples.en: March is the third month of the year.
examples.zh: 三月是一年的第三個月。

examples.en: Spring comes in March.
examples.zh: 春天在三月來到。

examples.en: Children's Day is on April fourth.
examples.zh: 兒童節是四月四日。

examples.en: April comes after March.
examples.zh: 四月在三月之後。

examples.en: Mother's Day is in May.
examples.zh: 母親節在五月。

examples.en: May is the fifth month of the year.
examples.zh: 五月是一年的第五個月。

examples.en: June is the sixth month of the year.
examples.zh: 六月是一年的第六個月。

examples.en: Many students finish school in June.
examples.zh: 許多學生在六月結束這學年。

examples.en: Summer vacation begins in July.
examples.zh: 暑假在七月開始。

examples.en: July is hot and sunny.
examples.zh: 七月又熱又晴朗。

examples.en: Father's Day in Taiwan is on August eighth.
examples.zh: 台灣的父親節是八月八日。

examples.en: August is the eighth month of the year.
examples.zh: 八月是一年的第八個月。

examples.en: School starts in September.
examples.zh: 學校在九月開學。

examples.en: Teachers' Day is on September twenty-eighth.
examples.zh: 教師節是九月二十八日。

examples.en: Taiwan's National Day is on October tenth.
examples.zh: 台灣的國慶日是十月十日。

examples.en: Halloween is on October thirty-first.
examples.zh: 萬聖節是十月三十一日。

examples.en: November is the eleventh month of the year.
examples.zh: 十一月是一年的第十一個月。

examples.en: The weather gets cooler in November.
examples.zh: 十一月天氣變涼了。

examples.en: Christmas is on December twenty-fifth.
examples.zh: 聖誕節是十二月二十五日。

examples.en: December is the last month of the year.
examples.zh: 十二月是一年的最後一個月。
